prs.title: Add missing Program and Project Methods
prs.author: iisaduan
prs.body:
Missing `Program` API methods: https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/pull/64749/changes#diff-4776036ff539c2fa009621dc13a9f2c8fd15d50e9302e8a361614ab640659a2eR117

-  `getProjectReferences()` - Direct project references declared for the program, or  undefined  when absent.
-  `getRootFileNames()` - Root file names supplied when creating the program or obtained from its configuration—not imported dependencies.
- `getStatistics()` - Returns counts for symbols, identifiers, instantiations, nodes, and types, as well as relaction cache sizes.

`Program` API methods deffered:
- `getSourceFiles()` - https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/pull/64988#pullrequestreview-5772779142
- `getResolvedProjectReferences() - https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/pull/64988#issuecomment-6648961939

`Program` API methods removed:
- `getTypeChecker()` - No longer in the ownership model
- `getOptionsDiagnostics()` - reduce duplicate methods
- `getTypeCount`, `getSymbolCount`, `getRelationCacheSizes`, `getIdentifierCount`, `getInstantiationCount`, `getNodeCount`- removed-- use `GetStatistics()`, which returns all of these

`Project` API Methods removed in order to reduce duplicate methods across objects
-  `containsFile`
-  `getFileNames`
-  `getRootFiles`
-  `hasRoots`,
-  `isRoot` 
-  `hasConfigFile`
-  `getSourceFile`

prs.title: Add regression test for inference recursion hang
prs.author: yusufyildiz34
prs.body:
Fixes #64701

> [!NOTE]
> **AI disclosure (per CONTRIBUTING.md):** I used an AI coding assistant for parts of the investigation, the test reduction and this description. I chose this issue myself, I have reviewed and understood the change, and I will handle review feedback myself.

## Analysis

The hang reported in #64701 no longer reproduces on `main`. It was fixed by #64553 ("Cache inferences made from type arguments"), which did not add a regression test for this scenario.

**Verification with the reporter's repro.** I ran the equivalent of the reporter's `api-probe.cjs` against the checker: it requests the return type of every call signature of every expression and its properties.
- On `5f5dee5b61`, the parent of #64553, `getReturnTypeOfSignature` for the type of `vi.mocked(createHandler)` did not return within 60s. The stack matches the one in the issue: `inferFromTypes` → `inferFromTypeArguments` → `inferFromTypes` → …
- On `main`, all 980 requests complete in about 0.5s.

**Root cause.** For two instantiations of the same type alias, `inferFromTypes` infers from their type arguments, and does the same for two references to the same generic type. Before #64553 it called `inferFromTypeArguments` directly on both paths. #64553 routes both through `invokeOnce`. `invokeOnce` skips a source/target pair it has already seen with the same priority and variance, and stops expanding when both sides are deeply nested.
